notes.title: Patch v1.1.4
notes.content:
Long time no see fellow Clerks, we've got a small update for you..

[list]
[*] Global optimization efforts to reduce stalls.
[*] Fixed an exploit that allowed players to collect two tickets when the train goes really fast.
[/list]
Have a great Watch, Clerks.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1.3
notes.content:
Oh oh oh, a new patch is upon you Clerks!

[list]
[*] Fixed a rare Soft-lock that could happen where the Capitale was allowing Player to enter the Chamber without any questions available inside.
[*] Fixed a crash that could happen if player looked at a zoom-able environment location while Mo wants to start a dialogue with them.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Air Can Achievement that sometimes didn't unlock.
[*] UI minor tweaks.
[/list]

Happy holidays to those who celebrate. 🎄🎄🎄

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Game Controller vibration support (can be turned off in the Menu).
[*] Harmonized Game Controller's support in the Game's Start Menu.
[*] Fixed the case of a player no-clipping in the Elevator and falling through the map.
[*] Fixed a rare Soft-lock that could happen when player was standing outside of a walkable area while pointing something at Mo.
[*] Moved the Skip elevator UI prompt on the side of the screen to not interfere with credits.
[*] The [spoiler]resignation[/spoiler] ending is now considered a death and will not reset Player's save.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a frequent Softlock that could happen if a Game Controller was used right after Player picks a two letter names and before the flag screen appears.
[*] Fixed a rare Softlock that could happen if Player White-whistled in the Horn while the train was stopped during the Threshold Event.
[*] Fixed a rare Softlock that made the tickets from the Punched Card machine non-grabbable.
[*] Fixed a rare crash that could happen if players managed to look at the Observatory and the Tower simultaneously.
[*] Minor fixes and timing tweaks.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Major improvements for both the freezes and the framerate drops.
[*] Fixed the softlock that could happen if you asked Mo about the Air Can machine.
[*] Added a feature to unstuck a player if they were trapped in-between the Mountain and Building 1.
[*] Fixed the LOD models for canisters making them properly visible from a distance.
[*] Y-Axis for the mouse can now be inverted in the Options.
[*] Fixed the post-processing darkening the image when you came back from the Capital Chambers.
[*] Tense music during the Revelation sequence no longer drops down in volume if you enter an area which muffles sounds (i.e. caves, Building 2).
[*] Train now constantly produces smoke from its exhaust system when running at high speeds.
[*] Updated the credits.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.9
notes.content:
- If the player dies by suffocating after the Threshold, saves won't be deleted anymore — giving more opportunities for the players to obtain one of the key endings.
- Fixed an issue that allowed Mo to write a message from the Underground Facility to the player.
- Fixed several prompts appearing at the wrong moment (when the player character reacts to the fish multiple times, and when the player used the key on the toilet).
- Fixed typos in French and English.
- Fixed buttons not disappearing from the ending screen, allowing the player to spam-click on them.
- Removed the ability to pause on the ending screen.
- Fixed the maximum amount of fishes that can be seen swimming in the river. Slightly reduced their chance of appearing.
- Improved the physics on the detachable plank from Building 1 (it used to exhibit some goofy physics when interacted with).
- During the Threshold event, if player remained next to the wall, the pile of bodies collisions wouldn't update. Now it will smoothly update to avoid players staying around, not knowing what to do.

notes.title: Hotfix V1.0.8
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a softlock where asking Mo about the grave [spoiler]after you dug it up[/spoiler] could take away player controls.
[*] Improved navigational mesh to potentially avoid Mo getting stuck on a rock near Building 1
[*] Fixed being able to infinitely restart the interaction with the hole in the wall
[*] Fixed the issue where the player character would think about outhouse "maybe the key I found can open it" [i]after[/i] opening it with the said key.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.7
notes.content:
[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a blocker that happened when player wanted to Interact with the [spoiler]hidden scaffolding leading to the Observatory [/spoiler].
[*] Camera now stops turning to the first Air Can supplied by the Air Can Machine after the first playthrough.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.6
notes.content:
[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a softlock that could happen if a country was selected too fast, which took away control from the player.
[*] Fixed a softlock with Mo getting stuck in the capital chamber.
[*] Fixed softlock that could happen with Mo if you asked him anything before running off somewhere else, and then went back to ask him about something else.
[*] Fixed a softlock where if the player died behind crates and Mo reached them there, he would get stuck behind the crates.
[*] Fixed the sky box obscuring the view of the Tower when [spoiler]fleeing through the mountains[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed a timing issue that might have caused the Questions to not properly trigger in the Capital Chambers.
[*] Fixed exploit that allowed the player to get infinite Air by getting into the Capital Chamber and then quickly leaving it.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented Mo from being able to look at the player upon loading the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the grave would be in an incorrect visual state if it was already dug by the player.
[*] Smoothed out the situation where player wouldn't get the [spoiler]Black whistle[/spoiler] in time, to avoid frustration
[*] Fixed visual issue with the wall mesh.
[*] Duckey can now get faster or bigger depending on how the player names it (all languages have their own set of matching names).
[*] If the player only [spoiler]stops the train instead of completely breaking the Bond[/spoiler], the Capital Message in the end will be slightly different.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.3
notes.content:
Greetings, Clerks! Another haul of bug fixes, improvements and Design Tweaks are upon us.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the player thoughts about the [spoiler]3 messages found[/spoiler] to play multiple times when getting close to Building 1 door.
[*] Fixed an issue that made the rocks falling from the cliff often stay stuck mid-air around the destroyed pine tree.
[*] Fixed an issue softlocking the player when they died for the first time after seeing the Train's contents.
[*] Fixed an issue softlocking the player if they hurried the Train to go as fast as possible before [spoiler]the mandatory full stop happens during the Story progression for the 1st time[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed an issue softlocking the player if they went to the Observatory and then back before seeing the Trains' contents.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a sound que when the air can machine becomes unusable, to highlight the loss of the Air Pressure.
[*] Improved the way water turns to blood. Still needs some work to be perfect.
[*] Darkened the blood on mouth UI and when player spits it out.
[*] Added gibs for the [spoiler]Animals falling from the wall[/spoiler].
[*] Added a sound that emphasizes the train passing the Border. Can only be heard after [spoiler]the mandatory full stop happens during the Story[/spoiler].
[*] Improved the "Broken Chains" outcome in the Capital Chambers and fixed some inconsistencies that were sometimes present during that sequence.
[*] Added the option to skip the Elevator Sequence (available once Player completed the game at least once).
[*] Now the Capital Chamber will react to the player spilling [spoiler]bucket contents in there[/spoiler].
[*] Mo runs quicker, his dialogue can be skipped faster, and some UI sequences are shortened after player completes the game at least once).
[/list]
[h3]Design Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Train will now keep slowing down until [spoiler]player makes the bridge to the Observatory[/spoiler].
[*] Slightly increased the time needed before the THRESHOLD happens once player cam uncover what's in [spoiler]the grave[/spoiler].
[/list]

[b]UPDATE: Hotfix 1.0.4.  - 11/25, 3 pm CET[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where if you've selected your country too quickly on a second run, your character could become stuck in place.
[/list]

Thanks for doing your part at the Border Post! [i]Back to work.[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.02
notes.content:
Greetings, Clerks! Another haul of bug fixes has arrived at the Border Post.

[quote]DISCLAIMER: [b]There was a major issue with how the script for auto-saving was handled.[/b] It's now fixed, but if you've got soft-locked before this update — you might still be in that state. We're very sorry, but the only solution in that situation would be to start a New Game.

Good news are — this issue was fixed, which should greatly improve the experience and eliminate A LOT of soft-locks![/quote]

[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Player's mouth UI would show an incorrect amount of blood.
[*] Fixed an issue where finishing the Bridge but not pushing it would soft-lock the SaveGame.
[*] Fixed an issue where Air Cans would get stuck in the Air Can provider and eventually block the other Air Cans from spawning.
[*] Fixed an issue where Mo would get soft-locked if the Player were to get dizzy while he waited for an interaction with them.
[*] Fixed an issue where Mo would get soft-locked if the Player discovered [spoiler]the Duck[/spoiler] just before [spoiler]witnessing what's in the train.[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Recycler's damage state would get reset.
[*] Fixed an issue that made Mo spam you with an infinite loop of empty messages.
[*] Fixed an issue that sometimes prevented Mo from congratulating the player on completing a pile of wood.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented the thought 'Question for the Capital' from triggering, locking away the ability to earn the corresponding Achievement.
[*] Fixed an issue that led the player to get buried under the mountain of bodies [spoiler]during the THRESHOLD Event.[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed an issue that made the train slow down to a crawl after loading a save file.
[*] Fixed a Player thought not appearing at the right moment — confusing them into thinking that stopping the train should be enough to stop the THRESHOLD and get the "Broken Bond" ending.
[*] Added a tracking zoom, which follows the Horn [spoiler]after it crashes into the roof[/spoiler], as many people tend to not notice it landed there.
[*] Other very minor fixes.[/list]

Thanks for doing your part at the Border Post! [i]Keep the train running.[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
- Preventing the removal of savegames in case of a death before the THRESHOLD.
- Fixed a collision issue.
- Fixed a visual issue in the Capital Chambers.
- Fixed a script issue with Mo.

notes.title: THRESHOLD is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, clerks![/h3]
The Capital has an urgent message for you — bringing the news of utmost importance. Your application to the position of Yellow Clerk has been reviewed and your candidacy has been approved. Don’t waste time and oxygen, [b]start your shift at the Border Post right now![/b]

The government wants you to view this short introduction video to get familiar with the job as quickly as possible.

[previewyoutube=jAqq9qqq5XQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Your responsibilities will include:
[list]
[*] Doing necessary maintenance on the Border Post.
[*] Cleaning and restoring the Border Post after your underqualified predecessor.
[*] Keeping your health in check, regulating your oxygen intake and condition of your gums. A healthy worker is a good worker!
[*] Serving [b]your[/b] country.
[*] Learning from your experienced partner - Mo, our exemplary employee. Look up to him!
[/list]
And most importantly:

[b]Give this job your all. Preserve air. Do not ask unnecessary questions. Train. Must. Run. [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2580020/THRESHOLD/

Additionally, the capital has received alarming news from a remote part of our country. Reports indicate increased solar activity as well as outbursts of violence and many recorded cases of paranoia among citizens. The government invites everyone to help the cause.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180070/No_Im_not_a_Human/

[h3]The country salutes its worker heroes![/h3]

Until further communications.
[i]Julien Eveillé and CR Channel[/i]

notes.title: THRESHOLD — Coming Nov 19th
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, clerks![/h3]

[b][i]The Capital is on the line![/i][/b] We'll cut to the chase — [b]THRESHOLD is releasing on November 19th[/b]. Enjoy this brand new trailer to provide you with a nice motivational boost.

[previewyoutube=DB91qE7Xap4;full][/previewyoutube]

We eagerly await all newcomers to the Border Post. [b]Starting Nov 19th, your duties will include[/b]:
[list]
[*] Familiarizing yourselves with the Border Post layout;
[*] Making sure the train passes the Border Post without any delays;
[*] Conserving air supply and keeping the usage of oxygen canisters under strict management;
[*] Cleaning water for the Capital
[*] Serving [i][b]your[/b][/i] Country[/list]
Remember, under no circumstances can you wonder into the forbidden areas, try to uncover any state secrets or [b]question what's in the train.[/b]

Also, don't forget, that [b]the currently available demo serves as a prologue to the main game and features unique story.[/b] So definitely give it a go.

In other news, [i]we've also found some concerning newspaper clippings[/i] — which, we suspect, [i]might be used in some sort of shadowy campaign[/i] to undermine the effectiveness and stability of the Border Post. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872527/209309a0ab8d037db65831112b9d86da6bc3b29d.jpg[/img]

If you [b]see any examples of these[/b] while on your shift — [b]be sure to contact your superiors[/b] and tell them about your findings.

notes.title: News, Publisher and Localizations
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, clerks![/h3]

[i]The Capital is on the line![/i] [b]While you were loyally serving your country, we got a publisher - CRITICAL REFLEX.[/b] 

Thanks in no small part to their efforts, the government expanded our budget to include more localizations, namely: [b][i]German, Spanish, Portuguese, Korean, Turkish, Ukrainian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Italian, Polish and Russian[/i][/b], as well as [b][i]French[/i][/b] translation made by yours truly.

[b]To celebrate this important moment of our project’s history, I’ve prepared a new trailer. [/b]
[i](Refusal to view can be considered a treason unless objective reasons are provided to local supervisor, see article 314b)
[/i]
